fact: Kenyans.co.ke reports ArdhiSasa is the government's digital platform for processing land services, including land searches, property transfers and title and lease registration, which an outage notice said were affected.
Kenyans.co.ke lists survey and mapping and valuation among the services offered through ArdhiSasa alongside land administration.
Kenyans.co.ke lists stamp duty payments and land-rent payments among the services offered through ArdhiSasa.

The Law Society of Kenya says Ardhisasa is a central platform for delivering land administration services, with searches, transfers and registrations disrupted when it was unavailable from 2026-09-01.
The State Department for Lands says the National Stamp Duty Module of ArdhiSasa is rolled out countrywide and that every transaction must go through Ardhisasa.
The State Department for Lands says standardized valuation data in the National Stamp Duty Module ensures stamp duty is assessed accurately.
The State Department for Lands says stamp duty is assessed and paid digitally through the NSDM within ArdhiSasa via Ardhipay, with KES1.946 billion collected in two months.
The State Department for Lands says Ardhisasa, built on NLIMS, offers searches, transfers and subdivisions online, with Isiolo County Blocks 1-10 live.

fact: The State Department for Lands says it continues rolling out Ardhisasa across counties, with Marsabit and Baringo next after Isiolo and Mombasa Island.

fact: The State Department for Lands and Physical Planning says that from 20 July 2026 all land transactions in the newly onboarded Mombasa registration sections are processed exclusively on the live Ardhisasa platform and manual processing ceases there, after earlier rollouts in Nairobi (2021), Murang'a, Isiolo, Mombasa Island and Mombasa Blocks XVI and XVII (21 July 2025).

The State Department for Lands and Physical Planning says it is progressively expanding the National Land Information Management System (Ardhisasa) to more registration sections and remains committed to a nationwide rollout.
